name: socratic
description: Adversarial N-agent debate as a decision aid: 2–5 deliberately differentiated debaters pin terminology, tag every claim by provenance and push back before conceding, clash until consensus survives a blind ballot or the debate stalls, and the moderator translates the outcome into a short recommendation. Each debate is logged for later continuation. /socratic starts a debate; /socratic-continue feeds the last one a new point.
